passage note: Dawn Collect and its concl: At the Christmas Mass at dawn, the Collect ends with Per eundem. The Collect for the commemoration of St Anastasia follows with Per Dominum. The Order of Mass gives both endings in full.
passage note: Dawn Secret and its conclu: At the Christmas Mass at dawn, the Secret ends with Per eundem. The Secret for the commemoration of St Anastasia follows with Per Dominum. The Order of Mass gives both endings in full.
passage note: Dawn Postcommunion and the: For the commemoration of St Anastasia, the Benziger Missal prints Satiásti, Dómine (p. 20), as given here. In this revision of Divinum Officium, the reference for the commemoration leads to Præsta nobis (C6b). Satiásti appears in the Common C6a. The Order of Mass gives the endings of the Postcommunion and the commemoration.
